learning_objectives: Convert coordinate strings into tuple format

tests.name: test_compare_records
test_create_record
test_clean_up
tests.unittest_code:
def test_clean_up(self):
    input_data = (
        ('Brass Spyglass', '4B', 'Seaside keep', ('4', 'B'), 'Blue'),
        ('Vintage Compass', '3D', 'Coastal cottage', ('3', 'D'), 'Yellow')
    )
    expected = "('Brass Spyglass', 'Seaside keep', ('4', 'B'), 'Blue')\n('Vintage Compass', 'Coastal cottage', ('3', 'D'), 'Yellow')\n"
    self.assertEqual(clean_up(input_data), expected)
